TRANSFERANDDISTRIBUTIONOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS PURSUANTTOSECTION81-642 OF THE ZONINGRESOLUTION OF THECITY OFNEWYORK THISTRANSFER AND DISTRIBUTION_OF DEVELOPMENTRIGHTS INSTRUMENT (this “Instrument") is made as of the Z" day of _J uE_, 2023, by and between THE VESTRY OF ST. BARTHOLOMEW'S CHURCH IN THE CITY OF NEW YORK, having an address at 325 Park Avenue, New York, New York 10022 ("Transferor"), and JPMORGAN CHASE BANK, N.A., having an address at 237 Park Avenue, New York, New York 10017 ("Transferee"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, pursuant to Sections 81-642 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the “Zoning Resolution"), the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission of the City of New York (the “CPC Chairperson") shall allow, by certification, the distribution of “floor area" (as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution) ("Floor Area") that is generated by a "granting lot”located in the East Midtown Subdistrict of the Special Midtown District to a "receiving lot” located in one or more subareas other than the Vanderbilt Corridor Subarea of the East Midtown Subdistrict (as such terms are defined in the Zoning Resolution); and WHEREAS, Transferor is the fee owner of that certain real property located in the County, B 1305 City and State of New York, which property is designated as Block 1305, Lot 1 on the Tax Map LI (the “Granting Lot"); and WHEREAS, Transferee is the fee owner of that certain real property located in the County, B1284 City and State of New York, designated as Block 1284, Lot 14 on the Tax Map of New York, as  14 Lot"); and WHEREAS, the Granting Lot is located in the East Midtown Subdistrict, partially within a C5-3 zoning district in the Park Avenue Subarea (the “C5-3 District") and partially within a C5- 2.5 zoning district that is partially in the Park Avenue Subarea and partially in the Other Transit Improvement Zone Subarea (the “C5-2.5 District"); and WHEREAS, the Granting Lot is a “granting lot,” as defined in Section 81-613 of the ZoningResolution; and WHEREAS, the maximum amount of Floor Area that may be transferred from a granting lot shall be the applicable basic maximum Floor Area as set forth in Section 81-64 of the Zoning Resolution, less the total Floor Area of all existing buildings on the zoning lot, and any previously transferredFloorArea; and WHEREAS, the Granting Lot has a lot area of 47,699 square feet, with 25,105 square feet located in the C5-3 District and 22,594 square feet located in the C5-2.5 District; and 1 US\29656367.v4

WHEREAS, pursuant to Sections 81-211 and 81-64 of the Zoning Resolution, the maximum permitted FAR in the C5-3 District is 15.0 and the maximum permitted FAR in the C5- 2.5 District is 12.0; and WHEREAS, the Granting Lot generates 647,703 square feet of floor area, and WHEREAS, the improvements on the Granting Lot utilize 69,218.2 square feet of Floor Area, and pursuant to that certain Notice of Restrictions of Development of Granting Site, dated as of October 15, 2021 and recorded in the office of the City Register on October 20, 2021 under City Register File Number 2021000412980, the Granting Lot has previously transferred 36,139.4 square feet of floor area to the property located at 415 Madison Avenue (Manhattan Block 1284, Lot 21); WHEREAS, accordingly, 542,345.4 square feet of Floor Area is available for transfer from the Granting Lot pursuant to Section 81-642 of the Zoning Resolution, and WHEREAS, the Receiving Lot is located in a C5-3 zoning district in the Northern Subarea oftheEastMidtownSubdistrict;and WHEREAS, the Receiving Lot is a “receiving lot,” as defined in Section 81-613 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, the Receiving Lot has a total lot area of 7,172.5 square feet; and WHEREAS, the increased Floor Area allowed by the transfer of development rights pursuant to Section 81-642 shall not exceed the amount resulting in the maximum Floor Area set forth inSection81-64,and WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 81-642 of the Zoning Resolution, the Receiving Lot has a basic maximum permitted FAR of 15.0, which may be increased to up to 18.0 in the Northern Subarea by the distribution of Floor Area from a “granting lot" located in the East Midtown Subdistrict; and WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 81-642 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor and Transferee have jointly filed an application, designated N 230130 ZCM, dated October 31, 2022 (the “Application") to the CPC Chairperson to allow, by certification, the distribution of 13,812 square feet of Floor Area from the Granting Lot to the Receiving Lot, thus reducing the maximum Floor Area permitted on the Granting Lot from 542,345.4 square feet to 528,533.4 square feet and increases the maximum Floor Area permitted on the Receiving Lot from 107,587.5 square feet to 121,399.5 square feet; and WHEREAS, the CPC Chairperson has certified the Application, thereby reducing the permitted maximum Floor Area on the Granting Lot to 528,533.4 and increasing the permitted maximum floor area on the Receiving Lot to 121,399.5 square feet. 2
